product.title: Grand Canyon Luxury Car Tour Experience

description.text: Travel the South Rim in a private luxury SUV with a dedicated guide who tailors stops to your interests. The route covers classic overlooks, Hermit Road viewpoints, and time at Grand Canyon Village with an optional lunch reservation at El Tovar Dining Room.

highlights: Private luxury SUV for your party only
Flexible four- to seven-hour South Rim itinerary
Hermit Road overlooks and hidden trail viewpoints
Optional El Tovar Dining Room lunch reservation
Hotel pickup available from Flagstaff and Sedona area

start.description: Private pickup from your Flagstaff, Sedona, or South Rim hotel. Your guide confirms timing and preferred overlooks before departure.

end.description: Return to your original pickup location after the final rim stop.

product.itinerarySummary: Travel the South Rim in a private luxury SUV with a dedicated guide who tailors stops to your interests.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon South Rim
itineraryItems.description: Scenic drive along Desert View Drive and rim roads with stops at major overlooks.

itineraryItems.title: Hermit Trail
itineraryItems.description: Visit Hermit Road viewpoints including trail overlooks above the inner canyon.

itineraryItems.title: El Tovar Dining Room
itineraryItems.description: Optional lunch stop at the historic El Tovar Hotel dining room on the rim.

itineraryItems.title: Lipan Point
itineraryItems.description: Photo stop at Lipan Point for wide views toward the Colorado River bend.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Grand Canyon Luxury Car Tour Experience?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 4 to 7 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at the Grand Canyon?
faqs.answer: Private pickup from your Flagstaff, Sedona, or South Rim hotel. Your guide confirms timing and preferred overlooks before departure.
